name: SMK Telkom Malang
address: Jl. Danau Ranau, Sawojajar, Kedungkandang, Kota Malang

notes.id: DSP per jalur: prioritas rapor Rp23.525.000 (ditutup); jalur potensi akademik Rp24.000.000; jalur tes akademik Rp25.000.000; International Class Program Rp28.525.000. DP Rp12.000.000, sisanya 4 kali angsuran. DSP mencakup DPP, seragam 5 stel + jas almamater, asuransi, MPLS, bahan ajar, ujian, PKL, kunjungan industri, perpisahan, dan SPP Juli. SPP Rp650.000 (reguler) / Rp850.000 (ICP) mulai Agustus 2027.
notes.en: Development fee by track: report-card priority Rp23,525,000 (closed); academic potential Rp24,000,000; academic test Rp25,000,000; International Class Program Rp28,525,000. Rp12,000,000 down payment, rest in 4 instalments. Covers DPP, 5 uniform sets + blazer, insurance, orientation, materials, exams, internship, industry visits, graduation and July tuition. Tuition Rp650,000 (regular) / Rp850,000 (ICP) from August 2027.

source.title: SPMB SMK Telkom Malang TA 2027/2028 (situs resmi)

period.id: Pendaftaran 10 Agustus–30 Oktober 2026; tes 31 Oktober 2026. Pendaftaran dapat ditutup bila kuota terpenuhi.
period.en: Registration 10 August–30 October 2026; test on 31 October 2026. May close early when full.

test.id: Nilai rapor, psikotes, tes kesamaptaan/fisik, wawancara siswa dan orang tua (jalur tes: CBT & logika).
test.en: Report grades, psychological test, fitness test, student and parent interview (test track: CBT & logic).

notes.id: Syarat: siswa kelas 9 SMP/MTs atau lulusan 1 tahun sebelumnya; tidak buta warna untuk RPL, TKJ, Animasi/Gim.
notes.en: Requirements: grade 9 students or graduates from the previous year; not colour-blind for software, networking and animation/game majors.

source.title: SPMB SMK Telkom Malang TA 2027/2028 (situs resmi)
